text:
The caress without cause slips from my fingers,

slips from my fingers... In the wind, as it passes,

the caress that wanders without destiny or object,

the lost caress—who will gather it?


I could love tonight with infinite pity,

I could love the first one who happened to arrive.

No one arrives. The flowered paths are alone.

The lost caress will roll... will roll...


If in your eyes they kiss you tonight, traveler,

if a sweet sighing shivers the branches,

if a small hand presses your fingers

that takes you and leaves you, that wins you and goes away.


If you do not see that hand, nor that mouth that kisses,

if it is the air that weaves the illusion of kissing,

oh, traveler, whose eyes are like the sky,

melted into the wind, will you recognize me?

translation.title: The Causeless Caress Slips from My Fingers...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the caress as an airborne, ownerless gesture seeking recognition.
